description: This Java class, CallScript, implements the processing of a <script> element within the Mini-language of the Ofbiz framework. It handles executing embedded scripts or external script files specified by attributes and is part of the call operations in the mini-lang 'simple method' processing system.

classes.name: CallScript
classes.description: Represents a <script> element operation that executes inline or external scripts within the mini-lang method processing.

classes.name: CallScriptFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CallScript from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: Adjusts the DOM element if old attribute 'error-list-name' is present; helpful during version migrations.

methods.name: CallScript
methods.description: Constructor that initializes CallScript with element attributes, validating and parsing script location and content.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the script, either by running an external script file or inline script, in the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <script> element with its attributes.
